lines.trans: Max, your grandmother and grandfather are at my home.
They decided to give us a surprise.
Did you not tell them anything?
No. And as I understood, neither did you.
Vika, you see, I forgot my razor at home.
I want to shave before the checkup.

We want to examine his heart.
Bring them here to the hotel, please.
I will explain everything to them myself.
Hello, where can I find the head chef?
There he is playing chess.
